capability: Hide the answer until you log a real try
title: Try first. Then the gate opens.

hook.picture: Close: the whale faces a puzzle dot on the line. An answer card sits right beside it, face up, and the whale glances at it at once.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: I read the answer, nodded, and forgot it by Friday.

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: A row of puzzle dots, each with a face-up answer card beside it. The whale glances at three cards, accelerating.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: The answer is always one glance away.

stakes.body: Hours of reading with nothing kept. The next puzzle starts from zero.

solution_hint: Hide the answer until you try.

metaphor.body: Each puzzle's answer card sits behind a gate. The whale's own line has to reach the puzzle and leave a tick before the gate opens.

steps.picture: A gate drops between the puzzle dot and its card. The card waits behind the gate, face down.
The whale works the puzzle: its line wobbles and bends (effort squash). It drops one tick on the strip, the gate opens and the card flips.
steps.words: Write down a try. Then it opens.

steps.picture: Push-in (z 1.3). The whale's wobbly line is laid against the card. Matching parts glow, and the parts that don't get a soft grenadine mark to retry.
steps.words: Now the answer lands on your work.
steps.sound: Bell, then a gentle second bell.

steps.picture: The next unopened puzzle dot pulls forward. The solved one slides back.
steps.words: Next: a puzzle you haven't opened.

real_case.claim: The noether-wiki repo indexes twenty-five monthly puzzles, September 2024 to September 2026. Its trainer keeps solutions hidden until you log an attempt and favours unopened problems.

honest_limit.picture: The whale drops a blank tick with no work on its line, and the gate opens anyway.
honest_limit.words: A blank try opens it too.

not_this.body: A logged try is not learning.

ending_pattern.body: The answer card waits behind the gate. The whale's own worked line reaches it and matches it, then the next-day puzzle is passed.
ending_pattern.callback: In FELT the card sat face up and the whale glanced at it. In the same framing the whale's own line now reaches the card first.

end_belief.body: Try before you look. Every time.
